# VF Empire

> VF Empire Corp Ltd (Malta, EU, registered C 94160) is a systems engineering house. It designs the engines, harnesses and command dashboards that make open-source AI models work as complete systems on hardware the owner controls, builds its own line of local-first, privacy-first software products, runs an AI Training Centre, and offers fixed-fee Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and GDPR consulting.

Key facts: founded 2019; based in Għajnsielem, Gozo, Malta; network companies Noirda GmbH (Germany) and Guardian Network (UK); contact info@vfempire.com. All products are local-first, EU-sovereign, ship with no third-party AI on user-data paths, and carry the Permanence Guarantee (refund plus source release if a product is discontinued; see Terms § 8).

## The method (pillar pages)

- [Helmsman Engine](https://vfempire.com/engine): VF Empire's orchestration engine; routes work across open models, gates every output against evidence, self-heals failures.
- [Harness Stack](https://vfempire.com/harness): what an AI harness is in VF's sense: process supervision, self-heal loops, project memory, evidence discipline.
- [Command Dashboards](https://vfempire.com/dashboards): fleet, lane, cost and outcome control surfaces for every VF system.
- [Glossary](https://vfempire.com/glossary): twenty defined terms (sovereign AI, harness, gate, reproducible build, transparency log, CRA, DPIA, SBOM, ARF and more).

## Services (fixed fee, EU)

- [All services](https://vfempire.com/services/): the three engagements compared side by side.
- [CRA Readiness Audit](https://vfempire.com/services/cra-readiness-audit): 2 weeks, €12-18k, gap analysis and remediation roadmap against Cyber Resilience Act Annex I and II.
- [Threat Model + DPIA Drafting](https://vfempire.com/services/threat-model-dpia): 3-4 weeks, €18-30k, regulator-ready threat model and data protection impact assessment.
- [Signing Infrastructure + SBOM Blueprint](https://vfempire.com/services/signing-infrastructure): 4-6 weeks, €25-40k, signed updates, transparency log, SBOM pipeline, reproducibility CI.

## Agents (one-time purchase, run on your hardware)

- [Agents overview](https://vfempire.com/agents): the VF agent fleet. Sovereign, one-time purchase agents that compose through a local fleet bus.
- [Re-Kon](https://vfempire.com/agents/re-kon): sovereign research and reconnaissance agent. Briefed once, returns a dossier with an evidence chain. Local, BYO model, BYO search.
- [Auto-Mate](https://vfempire.com/agents/auto-mate): floating-input agent summoned by a global hotkey. Runs machine tasks, browser tasks in a sandboxed bundled Chromium, or routes to other VF agents through the local fleet bus.

## Products and systems on the build slate

- [All 23 systems](https://vfempire.com/systems/): the filterable product index.
- [FileIT](https://vfempire.com/systems/fileit): the self-filing ledger, direct to HMRC MTD, ELSTER, CFR and ROS.
- [FuelIT](https://vfempire.com/systems/fuelit): the cheapest litre on your route across nine EU countries, with sovereign navigation.
- [NAV·IT](https://vfempire.com/systems/nav-it): self-hosted turn-by-turn navigator on open map data; ships inside FuelIT and MapIT.
- [MapIT](https://vfempire.com/systems/mapit): prices a whole shopping list at every store in your zone.
- [SnapIT](https://vfempire.com/systems/snapit): every drive scanned into one private photo and video library; live, one-off pricing from €59.
- [Guardian Shield](https://vfempire.com/systems/guardian-shield): vault, malware scanner, WireGuard VPN, DNS filter and breach watch on infrastructure you own.
- [VF Mail](https://vfempire.com/systems/vf-mail): a complete mail system of our own, in beta.
- [VF Wallet](https://vfempire.com/systems/vf-wallet): EU digital identity wallet built for people, ARF-conformant.
- [VF Legacy](https://vfempire.com/systems/vf-legacy): digital estate and succession, sealed instructions and executor packets.
- [VF Home](https://vfempire.com/systems/vf-home): smart-home hub with Matter, Zigbee, Z-Wave and local NVR.
- [Field Intelligence](https://vfempire.com/systems/field-intelligence): crop AI for family farms.
- [Private Care Watch](https://vfempire.com/systems/private-care-watch): in-home elder monitoring, private by architecture.
- [The Apprentice](https://vfempire.com/systems/the-apprentice): diagnostic copilot for the trades.
- [Everyday-Law Navigator](https://vfempire.com/systems/everyday-law-navigator): legal information for everyone else.
- [Triage & Continuity](https://vfempire.com/systems/triage-continuity): wellbeing check-in that routes to humans.
- [Site Truth Engine](https://vfempire.com/systems/site-truth-engine): construction progress verified from cameras already on site.
- [Grid & Home Optimiser](https://vfempire.com/systems/grid-home-optimiser): local energy intelligence for solar homes.
- [Self-Training QC Vision](https://vfempire.com/systems/self-training-qc-vision): defect detection a floor manager can teach.
- [Different-Minds Engine](https://vfempire.com/systems/different-minds-engine): adaptive learning built for neurodivergent students first.
- [Low-Resource Language AI](https://vfempire.com/systems/low-resource-language-ai): translation, teaching and preservation for the languages big tech skips, Maltese first.
- [Citizen Services Desk](https://vfempire.com/systems/citizen-services-desk): municipal AI on the municipality's own metal.
- [Claims Advocate](https://vfempire.com/systems/claims-advocate): AI on the policyholder's side.
- [Offline-First Response](https://vfempire.com/systems/offline-first-response): emergency coordination that survives the blackout.
